question: In population-based cohorts, is cerebral small vessel disease (and its MRI markers) associated with the risk of incident dementia and cognitive decline?
source: SYNERGY dataset Bos_2018; 'Cerebral small vessel disease and the risk of dementia' (Alzheimers Dement 2018, doi:10.1016/j.jalz.2018.04.007); gold = label_included==1 rows with DOI via [AID]
notes: Created with make_fixture.py. No baseline strategy: use evals/generate.py (Phase 2). Harness reports reachable vs. unreachable gold separately.

version_change.decision_source: Evaluation fixture author; scope derived from the source systematic review.

review.question: In population-based cohorts, is cerebral small vessel disease (and its MRI markers) associated with the risk of incident dementia and cognitive decline?

framework.name: PECO (population, exposure, comparator, outcome)
framework.rationale: An observational association question. PECO separates the exposure (cerebral small vessel disease and its MRI markers) and the outcome (incident dementia / cognitive decline), which drive retrieval, from the cohort design and exposure gradient, which are screening-only.

slots.label: Exposure
slots.description: Cerebral small vessel disease and its MRI markers (white matter hyperintensities, lacunes, silent infarcts, microbleeds).

inclusion.label: Population-based cohort
inclusion.description: A population-based or longitudinal cohort of community-dwelling participants.

inclusion.label: Cerebral small vessel disease
inclusion.description: Exposure is cerebral small vessel disease or an MRI marker of it (white matter hyperintensity, lacunar/silent infarct, cerebral microbleed, vascular brain injury).

inclusion.label: Incident dementia / cognitive decline
inclusion.description: Outcome is incident dementia, Alzheimer disease, or cognitive decline/impairment.

inclusion.label: Longitudinal observational design
inclusion.description: A prospective cohort / longitudinal observational study with follow-up.

exclusion.label: Not small vessel disease
exclusion.description: Exposure is not cerebral small vessel disease or an MRI marker of it.

exclusion.label: No dementia/cognition outcome
exclusion.description: Does not report a dementia or cognitive-decline outcome.

exclusion.label: Not a population cohort
exclusion.description: Not a population-based/longitudinal cohort (e.g. cross-sectional clinical sample).

concepts.label: Cerebral small vessel disease / MRI markers
concepts.definition: The exposure: cerebral small vessel disease and the MRI markers used to operationalize it - white matter hyperintensities/lesions, lacunar and silent brain infarcts, cerebral microbleeds, and vascular brain injury. Retrieval must not depend on the single phrase 'small vessel disease', which most primary studies do not use.
concepts.rationale: A fragile essential concept: eligible studies name specific markers (microbleeds, white matter hyperintensity, silent infarcts) far more often than 'small vessel disease', so broad marker synonymy is essential to recall.

concepts.label: Dementia / cognitive decline
concepts.definition: The outcome: incident dementia, Alzheimer disease, and cognitive decline or impairment.
concepts.rationale: A stable essential concept co-anchoring the search with the exposure.

properties.label: Population-based / longitudinal cohort
properties.instructions: Confirm at screening that the study is a population-based/longitudinal cohort with follow-up. Apply no study-design search filter.
properties.recall_rationale: Cohort/design terms are inconsistently indexed in titles/abstracts; a design filter would arbitrarily drop eligible cohorts.

properties.label: Incident outcome across SVD burden
properties.instructions: Confirm at screening that dementia/cognitive decline is an incident outcome assessed across small-vessel-disease burden. Do not add a comparator or 'incident' AND block.
properties.recall_rationale: 'Incident' and burden-gradient wording is variable and often absent from abstracts; as a block it bottlenecks recall.

decisions.label: Methodological (study-design) filter
decisions.rationale: Recall-first evaluation build; the cohort design is confirmed at screening, not by a search-time hedge.

decisions.label: Database limits
decisions.rationale: No language, age, species, publication-status, or date limits for the recall-first evaluation build.

date_boundaries.rationale: No date boundaries; the evaluation scores against a fixed gold set.

recall.policy: Recall first; decline the optional no-seed heuristic during evaluation because hidden gold is scored independently.

workload.policy: Do not narrow solely because retrieval is large.
workload.selection_rule: Workload may choose only among variants that meet the held-out recall requirement.

protocol_status: tightened; lock-validated and compiled. Naive 2-block scope (cerebral SVD/MRI markers x dementia/cognition) recalls 9/9 gold at ~11k hits; broad because the exposure is operationalized through many MRI-marker synonyms.
